summary: Arrange the input square and its three quarter-turn rotations into a doubled square.
src: entire n x n input grid
dst: 2x2 grid of n x n quadrants
transform: place the original grid in the upper-left, its 90-degree counterclockwise rotation in the upper-right, its 180-degree rotation in the lower-left, and its 270-degree counterclockwise rotation in the lower-right
